test_title: PYST 4: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 13th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Rearrange the sentences into a coherent paragraph:

1. This ensures food is safe and free from harmful microorganisms.

2. Food processing includes methods that convert raw materials into edible items.

3. These methods range from simple cutting to complex fermentation or pasteurization.

4. It also helps extend shelf life and improve nutritional value.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The paragraph explains the concept and purpose of food processing in a logical sequence.
 
• **Sentence 2** is the first sentence as it introduces the concept of food processing:
 
 
• "Food processing includes methods that convert raw materials into edible items."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 3** follows as it elaborates on the range of methods involved in food processing:
 
 
• "These methods range from simple cutting to complex fermentation or pasteurization."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 1** is next as it highlights the importance of ensuring food safety:
 
 
• "This ensures food is safe and free from harmful microorganisms."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 4** concludes the paragraph by emphasizing the benefits of food processing:
 
 
• "It also helps extend shelf life and improve nutritional value."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **2, 3, 1, 4**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"Food processing includes methods that convert raw materials into edible items. These methods range from simple cutting to complex fermentation or pasteurization. This ensures food is safe and free from harmful microorganisms. It also helps extend shelf life and improve nutritional value."
